independence: Uses the pinned streaming tokenizer only; row validation, expected ordered input identities, side scoring, map grouping, exact binomial tails and gate decisions computed locally without compare.py/confirm.py metric functions. No simulations or policy edits.
limits: One procedural distribution and six fixed references; does not establish current online-ladder or universal tournament strength.
Maps/sides/references are correlated; inferential gates use predeclared map grouping. Development selected adaptively, confirmation tests the combined package, without per-feature fresh ablation.
Engine version is verified from actual statistics; official generator engine hash is not proof of CLI engine injection.
Reported faults/reinitialization markers and caught SDK/low-fuel samples are separate diagnostics. Zero reported faults is not zero caught errors.

Native validation flags and no-exposed-byte-overlap were checked, but native map integrity/engine verification was not rerun by this audit. Historical exposure manifest values are used for exclusion; historical native files are not all rehashed here.
